filters.name: Set Mesh Camera
filters.shortDescription: Set the camera parameters for the current mesh.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Set camera parameters for the current mesh. The camera is stored and used by other filters such as 'Vertex Quality from Camera'.

parameters.label: Viewpoint
parameters.help: Camera position in world space.

parameters.label: View direction
parameters.help: Camera viewing direction.

parameters.label: Focal length (mm)
parameters.help: Camera focal length in millimeters.

parameters.label: Camera type
parameters.help: Type of camera projection.

filters.name: Set Raster Camera
filters.shortDescription: Set the camera parameters for the current raster.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Set camera parameters for the current raster. The viewport is automatically recalculated from the raster image dimensions.

parameters.label: Viewpoint
parameters.help: Camera position in world space.

parameters.label: View direction
parameters.help: Camera viewing direction.

parameters.label: Focal length (mm)
parameters.help: Camera focal length in millimeters.

parameters.label: Sensor width (mm)
parameters.help: Camera sensor width in millimeters.

filters.name: Vertex Quality from Camera
filters.shortDescription: Compute vertex quality using the camera definition, according to viewing angle or distance.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Compute vertex quality using the camera definition, according to viewing angle or distance. Uses the current raster camera if available.

parameters.label: Use depth
parameters.help: Use depth from camera as a factor (quality proportional to distance).

parameters.label: Use facing angle
parameters.help: Use cosine of viewing angle as a factor.

parameters.label: Clip outside viewport
parameters.help: Clip quality values to zero for vertices outside the camera viewport.

parameters.label: Normalize
parameters.help: If checked normalize all quality values in range [0..1].

parameters.label: Map to color
parameters.help: If checked map quality generated values into per-vertex color.

filters.name: Transform: Rotate Camera or set of cameras
filters.shortDescription: Rotate the camera, or all the cameras of the project.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Rotate the camera, or all the cameras of the project. The selected raster is the reference if viewpoint rotation is selected.

parameters.label: Target camera
parameters.help: Choose the camera to rotate.

parameters.label: Rotation axis
parameters.help: Axis of rotation.

parameters.label: Rotation center
parameters.help: Center of rotation.

parameters.label: Rotation angle
parameters.help: Angle of rotation in degrees.

parameters.label: Custom axis
parameters.help: Rotation axis used only if 'custom axis' option is chosen.

parameters.label: Custom center
parameters.help: Rotation center used only if 'custom point' option is chosen.

parameters.label: Apply to all active rasters
parameters.help: Apply the same rotation to all active raster layers. Used only if 'Raster Camera' is selected.

parameters.label: Apply to all visible cameras
parameters.help: Apply the same rotation to all visible raster and mesh layers.

filters.name: Transform: Scale Camera or set of cameras
filters.shortDescription: Scale the camera, or all the cameras of the project.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Scale the camera, or all the cameras of the project.

parameters.label: Target camera
parameters.help: Choose the camera to scale.

parameters.label: Scaling center
parameters.help: Center of scaling.

parameters.label: Custom center
parameters.help: Scaling center used only if 'custom point' option is chosen.

parameters.label: Scale factor
parameters.help: The scale factor to apply to the camera.

parameters.label: Apply to all active rasters
parameters.help: Apply the same scaling to all active raster layers.

parameters.label: Apply to all visible cameras
parameters.help: Apply the same scaling to all visible raster and mesh layers.

filters.name: Transform: Translate Camera or set of cameras
filters.shortDescription: Translate the camera, or all the cameras of the project.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Translate the camera, or all the cameras of the project.

parameters.label: Target camera
parameters.help: Choose the camera to translate.

parameters.label: X translation
parameters.help: Absolute translation amount along the X axis.

parameters.label: Y translation
parameters.help: Absolute translation amount along the Y axis.

parameters.label: Z translation
parameters.help: Absolute translation amount along the Z axis.

parameters.label: Translate viewpoint to origin
parameters.help: If selected, the camera viewpoint is translated to the origin.

parameters.label: Apply to all active rasters
parameters.help: Apply the same translation to all active raster layers.

parameters.label: Apply to all visible cameras
parameters.help: Apply the same translation to all visible raster and mesh layers.

filters.name: Transform camera extrinsics
filters.shortDescription: Apply a similarity transformation to the camera extrinsics.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Apply a similarity transformation to the camera extrinsics, or all the cameras of the project.

parameters.label: Target camera
parameters.help: Choose the camera to transform.

parameters.label: Matrix semantic
parameters.help: How the transformation matrix is interpreted.

parameters.label: Rotation (degrees)
parameters.help: Rotation angles around X, Y, Z axes in degrees.

parameters.label: Translation
parameters.help: Translation vector.

parameters.label: Uniform scale
parameters.help: Uniform scale factor.

parameters.label: Apply to all active rasters
parameters.help: Apply the same transformation to all active raster layers.

parameters.label: Apply to all visible cameras
parameters.help: Apply the same transformation to all visible raster and mesh layers.

filters.name: Re-Orient vertex normals using cameras
filters.shortDescription: Reorient vertex normals to point toward the cameras that see them best.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Reorient vertex normals using visible rasters. For each vertex, the best camera is chosen among all visible rasters and the normal is oriented to face toward that camera. If the per-vertex attribute 'correspondences' exists (from Bundler .out imports), the original Bundler camera indices are used instead.
